import sys, json

import stress, importlib.util

req = stress.build(threshold=True, S=1, W=1)
names, types, domains = m.validate_schema(req['schema'])
fidx = {n:i for i,n in enumerate(names)}
fns = [m.compile_atom(a, req['window'], types, fidx) for a in req['atoms']]
natoms = len(fns)
tt = m.parse_traces(req['train'], types, domains, set(), [0])
pt = m.parse_traces(req['probes'], types, domains, set(), [0])
tc, tm = m.build_contexts(tt, req['window'], True)
pc, _ = m.build_contexts(pt, req['window'], False)
train_vecs = [[fn(c) for fn in fns] for c in tc]
probe_vecs = [[fn(c) for fn in fns] for c in pc]
n_train, n_probe = len(tc), len(pc)
full=(1<<n_train)-1; probe_full=(1<<n_probe)-1
pos=[0]*natoms; bit=1
for vec in train_vecs:
    for a,v in enumerate(vec):
        if v: pos[a]|=bit
    bit<<=1
lit_mask=[]
for a in range(natoms):
    lit_mask.append(pos[a]); lit_mask.append(full^pos[a])
